description:
Context: plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/fleet-bridge.mjs hard-codes .adlc/fleet-logs/<id>.log for tail panes and packages/fleet/lib/status.mjs does not publish logDir in fleet-status.json (#836). Also, the comment above fleetTailPaneArgs in fleet-bridge.mjs omits --tab from the supported flag list (#837).
Requirements:
1. Have newStatus in packages/fleet/lib/status.mjs accept an optional logDir field and pass it from packages/fleet/lib/run.mjs when statusDir is provided.
2. Have planFleetBridge in plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/fleet-bridge.mjs validate and use curr.logDir when present, falling back to .adlc/fleet-logs when absent or unsafe, and clarify the --tab flag comment above fleetTailPaneArgs.
3. Add unit tests in packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs and plugins/adlc-herdr/test/fleet-bridge.test.mjs.
title: fix(adlc-herdr,fleet): honor relocated status logDir in fleet tail panes and clarify --tab comment (#836, #837)
